overview: StudyForge is a study platform with a public dynamic QR code generator, a private notes workspace, and full study tools.
features: Create dynamic QR codes that redirect to an editable destination
Download QR codes as PNG or SVG with custom colors and size
Track scans per day with device and country, no raw IPs
Manage links via a secret edit link: change target, pause, delete
Write notes in a block editor with autosave and search
Preview notes read-only and share them via a link with a QR code
Configure account, study profile, appearance, and privacy in Settings
Study tools: classes, subjects, chapters, topics, questions, practice, analytics
